commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "STEP: baseline module state"
lsmod | grep -i usb_storage || echo "usb_storage not currently loaded"
uname -r

echo "STEP: write blacklist config"
sudo -n tee /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf >/dev/null <<'EOF'
blacklist usb-storage
install usb-storage /bin/false
EOF
cat /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf

echo "STEP: remove module now if loaded"
if lsmod | grep -qi '^usb_storage'; then
  sudo -n modprobe -r usb_storage || sudo -n rmmod usb_storage
fi

echo "STEP: rebuild initramfs so blacklist applies at boot"
KVER="$(uname -r)"
if command -v dracut >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo -n dracut -f "/boot/initramfs-${KVER}.img" "${KVER}"
else
  echo "dracut not found" >&2
  exit 1
fi

echo "STEP: verify blacklist recognized by modprobe config"
sudo -n modprobe --showconfig | grep -i usb-storage

echo "STEP: verify not currently loaded"
lsmod | grep -i usb_storage && echo "STILL LOADED - FAIL" || echo "OK: not loaded"

echo "STEP: verify initramfs contains blacklist conf"
lsinitrd "/boot/initramfs-${KVER}.img" 2>/dev/null | grep -i blacklist-usb-storage || echo "WARN: not found in initramfs listing (may still be included)"

echo "DONE"
commands.stdout:

blacklist usb-storage
install usb-storage /bin/false
